print.label: print()
print.reminder: print() shows something on the screen. Commas let you print several things at once.

string.label: text (strings)
string.reminder: Text goes inside quotes. + joins two pieces of text and * repeats one.

number.label: numbers and sums
number.reminder: Python does sums with + - * and /. // shares out whole things and % gives what is left over.

variable.label: variables
variable.reminder: A variable is a name for a value. The value on the right goes into the name on the left.

input.label: input()
input.reminder: input() asks a question and waits. Whatever is typed comes back as text.

comment.label: comments
comment.reminder: A line that starts with # is a note for people. Python skips it.

type-conversion.label: int(), float() and str()
type-conversion.reminder: int() turns text into a whole number, float() into a decimal and str() turns a number into text.

f-string.label: f-strings
f-string.reminder: Put f before the quotes, then put values inside curly brackets.
